task.title: P6-185: Cross-engine check for menu-key keydown contextmenu suppression
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 10 — Hygiene and docs). Original id: P6-185. Size: S. Specs: specs/app-ui.md, specs/ui-components.md.

**`prevent_default()` on the menu-key keydown suppresses the synthesized `contextmenu` only on engines that fire it from keydown** (was `P6-024f`; `tree.rs:437`); where it fires from keyup, the row's `on:contextmenu` re-fires `open_at(0,0)` and re-parks the panel in the viewport corner. Confirmed as a code shape; **the browser behavior itself is unverified** and needs a cross-engine check — which is `P6-081`'s job, so land it with that or leave the note.
